description: Reads a job description (text or an https link) or a few sentences about a role and returns a structured brief (must-have and nice-to-have skills, years, regions, budget), the questions it leaves open, and a ballpark monthly cost. Ask the user the openQuestions, then pass the brief to search_candidates. The first call is free; after that it needs the user's verified email (lead_token from verify_email).

job_description_url.description: An https link to the job description (a job post, PDF or Word file).

lead_token.description: leadToken from verify_email. Needed after the first free call.

text.description: The job description or a description of the role, as text.

name: scope_role
title: Turn a role description into a hiring brief
